summary: Tradeability-aware candidate review surface that preserves research signal but ranks by hard class before within-class score.
what_v2_rewards: discovery-time research score preserved from decision tier, determinism ratio, resource sanity, and context cleanliness
deterministic within-class ranking using research score as the primary tie-break after class assignment
pack-level shadow evidence quality when present
what_v2_newly_rewards: bound directional runtime truth over research-only or observe-only families
what_v2_hard_guards: OBSERVE_ONLY can never outrank any runnable directional class
UNRUNNABLE can never outrank any runnable directional class
UNSEEN, NO_SIGNAL, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and WEAK are distinct classes
negative evidence is never collapsed into no-evidence
what_v2_explicitly_does_not_confuse: observe-only support families with runnable directional candidates
insufficient sample with negative realized evidence
translation present with runnable tradeability truth
